purpose: Define a minimal long-term RSLG-SLAM docs/manifest set and deletion/merge preconditions for nonessential planning files. This plan does not delete, move, rename, or overwrite existing artifacts.

retention_categories.core_keep_stable: Long-term project truth or contract. Tracked and rarely changed.
retention_categories.core_keep_frequently_updated: Long-term status/truth file updated by validation tasks.
retention_categories.keep_until_implemented_then_merge_or_del: Useful active planning file that should be merged, archived, or deleted after implementation.
retention_categories.merge_candidate: Content should later be merged into a smaller canonical file.
retention_categories.archive_candidate: Useful historical planning evidence, not an active long-term contract.
retention_categories.delete_candidate_after_merge: Delete later only after content is merged or no longer needed.
retention_categories.task_evidence_only: Should remain only as task evidence, not a long-term docs contract.
retention_categories.unknown_requires_manual_review: Do not delete; requires user decision.

files.current_role: Human-readable project identity, input contract, and claim-boundary contract.
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Loss of concise human-readable project truth and claim boundaries.

files.current_role: Human-readable layer naming and pipeline architecture contract.
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Layer naming may drift, especially World Model Layer versus historical Stage-A wording.

files.current_role: Human-readable workspace organization contract.
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Future tasks may lose the intended separation between source, docs, task evidence, and generated outputs.

files.current_role: Human-readable anti-bloat retention policy created by task25f.
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Future tasks may recreate manifest bloat without a concise policy reference.

files.current_role: Temporary human-readable plan for future .gitignore changes; .gitignore was not modified by task25d or task25f.
delete_or_merge_preconditions: User manually finalizes .gitignore or explicitly rejects the proposed rules.
Any durable workspace policy is merged into docs/rslg_slam/manifests/workspace_policy_manifest_v0_1.json.
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Future cleanup may lose rationale for generated-output ignore rules before .gitignore policy is decided.

files.current_role: Patch candidate for .gitignore; should not be a long-term docs contract.
delete_or_merge_preconditions: User manually applies, revises, or rejects the candidate .gitignore patch.
If accepted, durable policy is reflected in .gitignore and workspace policy.
files.merge_target_if_any: stage_outputs/.../tasks/task25d... or workspace policy if still needed
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Deleting before user decision removes the exact candidate patch proposal.

files.current_role: Temporary human-readable migration plan toward tools/rslg_pipeline/.
delete_or_merge_preconditions: tools/rslg_pipeline/ skeleton and no-op validators exist.
Migration plan is reflected in code, tests, or the entrypoint mapping.
Legacy script handling is documented.
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Migration work could lose the intended target layout and no-delete migration constraints.

files.current_role: Large static mapping from current scattered scripts to future canonical entrypoints.
delete_or_merge_preconditions: Canonical tools/rslg_pipeline/ entrypoints exist.
Validators cover migrated/no-op behavior.
Remaining legacy mappings are archived or summarized in a compact canonical file.
files.merge_target_if_any: future compact tool contract or implemented tools/rslg_pipeline/ docs
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Deleting too early would break migration traceability for existing scripts.

files.current_role: Temporary human-readable future test plan; no validators implemented by task25e or task25f.
delete_or_merge_preconditions: Real validators/tests are implemented.
Remaining stable test expectations are merged into pipeline contract or a future compact test contract.
files.risk_if_deleted_too_early: Future validator work could lose planned test groups and no-runtime/no-rerun safety boundaries.
